import gzip,json,shutil
from pathlib import Path
from nisayon.engine.io import file_digest,write_json
raw=Path('artifacts/engine-integration-001/confirmation-engine-001')
out=Path('docs/experiments/results/confirmation-engine-001')
copied=[]
for name in ['consumption-001.json','export-audit-001.json','original-input-audit.json','finite-readback.json','D01-gripper-sign-evaluation.json','D05-recurrent-carry-evaluation.json']:
 target=out/name
 shutil.copyfile(raw/name,target)
 copied.append({'path':name,'sha256':file_digest(target)})
for stem,relative in [('profile-initial','profile-001/profile.json'),('profile-corrected','profile-002/profile.json'),('recovery','recovery-001/recovery.json'),('export-manifest','full-export-002/manifest.json'),('export-timing','full-export-002/timing.json'),('costs','full-export-002/costs.json')]:
 target=out/(stem+'.json')

 copied.append({'path':target.name,'sha256':file_digest(target),'source_path':str(raw/relative)})
data=(raw/'full-export-002/view.json').read_bytes()
target=out/'view.json.gz'
with target.open('xb') as stream:
 stream.write(gzip.compress(data,mtime=0))
copied.append({'path':target.name,'sha256':file_digest(target),'bytes':target.stat().st_size,'uncompressed_sha256':file_digest(raw/'full-export-002/view.json'),'uncompressed_bytes':len(data)})
